s1.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular compromise
key_facts: 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
invasion of the superior vena cava
thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
symptomatic relief with heparin and corticosteroids
multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells

raw.syndrome_frame: mediastinal mass with respiratory and vascular compromise
key_facts: 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
invasion of the superior vena cava
thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
symptomatic relief with heparin and corticosteroids
multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells

differentials: Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura
Solitary fibrous tumor of the pleura

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: WT1 positivity and CD99 positivity are characteristic of this tumor

shortlist.label: Ewing's sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD99 positivity is a hallmark of Ewing's sarcoma, and the patient's age and symptoms are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: CD99 positivity and small, round, monomorphic cells are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's symptoms and the presence of a large mediastinal mass are consistent with lymphoma

shortlist.label: Germ cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's age and the location of the tumor in the anterior superior mediastinum are consistent with a germ cell tumor

raw.rationale: The patient's histopathology showing a multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm and immunohistochemistry demonstrating diffuse strong WT1 positivity are characteristic of Desmoplastic small round cell tumor

rejected.label: Ewing's sarcoma
rejected.why: While Ewing's sarcoma can present with small round cell morphology, the immunohistochemistry profile does not match as closely as it does for Desmoplastic small round cell tumor, particularly with the strong WT1 positivity

rejected.label: Primitive neuroectodermal tumor
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely due to the specific combination of histopathological and immunohistochemical findings presented, which are more characteristic of Desmoplastic small round cell tumor

rejected.label: Mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The description of small, round, monomorphic cells and specific immunohistochemical markers does not align with the typical presentation of mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma

rejected.label: Germ cell tumor
rejected.why: Germ cell tumors can present in the mediastinum but the specific histological and immunohistochemical features described are not typical for germ cell tumors
